name: Md. Atiq Shahriar

experiences.description: Developed an energy‑aware federated learning framework for ICU mortality prediction using MIMIC‑IV data across 11 heterogeneous simulated ICU clients. Designed a client selection strategy that reduced training energy by 31.7% while achieving 0.8190 AUROC compared with full‑participation FedAvg. Investigated the relationship between client heterogeneity, predictive performance, and training energy in federated healthcare learning.
